title: GameMaker Library: Smithereens added, 86 assets
body:
Smithereens is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 86 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for effects, animation and game feel, and the file NEW 2026-11-10: Smithereens only holds Smithereens alone, so you only download what changed.

What Smithereens is

  • Strike any sprite and it breaks into pieces cut from the exact frame your instance is showing, so a break always matches your art. Pure GML, with a runnable demo room, THE OLD COURTYARD: a hero with a sword and 26 props to break, all drawn in code.
  • Seven materials break seven different ways: curved sherds for pottery, splinters along the grain for wood, angular chunks for stone, wedges for crystal, slabs and a melt puddle for ice, clippings over a rooted stub for foliage, plain chunks for anything else.
  • Pieces bounce, slide and settle, turn in quarter turns only so pixel art stays on its grid, cast a contact shadow and lie as debris. Pixel art drawn larger, or already scaled up in its file, breaks along its own art pixels.
  • Gathering nodes: an ore rock that takes three strikes cracks from where the first blow landed, loses a chip each strike, breaks on the last and grows back. Save and load included.
  • It is a port of our RPG Maker MZ plugin, and its test suite holds the GML to the original: 189 breaks give the same pieces pixel for pixel, and 300 steps of physics match.

It is the second of three Swing, Smash and Soar systems for action adventure games, after Brandish.

Also today: Forage now ships its current build, the one its tests ran on. The library had been serving the older file from its page.

The library now holds 86 assets worth $1,089.14 bought one by one, for $19.99; 6 of them are effects, animation and game feel. Every new asset joins on its launch day. The price rises as the library grows: $5 more for new buyers each time three more assets join, $24.99 at 89 assets and $29.99 at 92, never more, and every step will be announced here first with its date. If you own it, you never pay again. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
